design.purpose: go/no-go feasibility of supervision-versus-verification budget allocation
design.data: stored clean regional vote counts and reconstructed client held-out joint counts (3000/3000 exact reconstruction gate)

class_target.rule: private candidate AND gain lower > 0 AND min simultaneous recall lower (direct linear bands) > r0

design.reference: phi=(.5,.25,.25), the published fixed split, re-run with fresh noise in this same design
design.naming_noise: one fresh exact release per (seed, epsilon, phi_naming), shared by all draws and targets with that phi
design.outcome: unconditional independent-test accuracy of the published classifier (public fallback on rejection); acceptance rate
design.selection_honesty: best allocation chosen on draws 0-49, evaluated on draws 50-99
design.go_criterion: for gain or class(r0=0) target at >=2 of 4 epsilons: held-out-draw improvement of the selected allocation over reference >= 1.0 point with cohort-paired 95% t-interval excluding 0; and an interior optimum (phi_naming not at grid edge) for >=1 epsilon
design.registered_prediction: optimal naming share decreases as total epsilon grows, because candidate quality saturates while verification remains noise-limited
design.seeds_noise: sha256-derived replay keys with prefix ALLOC-20261019; distinct from all earlier keys
